messages:
pagerduty-bot: [ALERT] High-rate auth proxy anomalies detected. 401 -> repeated token reuse pattern; sampling shows potential header snippets in s3://staging-rt-archive. Suspected log forwarder misconfig + credential exposure. Pager: @raj_oncall

raj_oncall: ack. oncall taking. ETA to triage 2m. can someone grab a quick list of affected buckets and recent deploys?

lina_security: I'm on it. pulling telemetry now. initial classifier flags ~1200 suspicious requests in last 30m from ~45 unique IPs; some requests reference svc-proxy bearer tokens. Not sure if customer tokens included yet.

emily_sre: confirm: auth-proxy v2.4.1 rolled ~04:12UTC per deploy bot. I'll check pod logs and replication rules.

miguel_ops: found recent logshipper config change at 04:09UTC that enabled gzip+indexing to staging-rt-archive. Pausing ingestion now.

runbook-bot: Recommended playbook: Incident -> AUTH-EXFIL-PLAY v1.2. Steps: isolate storage, snapshot logs, rotate svc tokens, stop forwarder. Quick commands: ```sh
# pause logshipper k8s deployment
kubectl -n infra scale deploy logshipper --replicas=0
# snapshot bucket (metadata only)
aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket staging-rt-archive --versioning-configuration Status=Suspended
```

raj_oncall: emily/miguel, please pause ingestion + create bucket snapshot. lina, start quick triage for customer token leakage. I'll create an incident channel.

emily_sre: paused logshipper, confirmed replicas=0. created k8s job to collect last 2 minutes of pods’ stdout to artifacts: s3://incident-artifacts/2833337777/snapshots.tar.gz

miguel_ops: added temporary WAF rule to block suspicious IP CIDR ranges and disabled external log forwarder role. IAM policy update in progress.

lina_security: quick grep on sampled logs: found 3 distinct bearer token fragments that decode to format matching ephemeral customer tokens (short-lived). Flagging as potentially customer-facing. Collecting list of affected customer org IDs now.

sophie_legal: preserve chain-of-custody. Do not send deletion requests. Document every step — timestamps & actor IDs. I'll stand by for customer comms review.

raj_oncall: action items (short):
- emily_sre: collect pod logs snapshot and retention hold (done/in progress)
- miguel_ops: rotate logshipper service account keys, revoke forwarding role, update IAM (in progress)
- lina_security: full list of potentially affected customers + risk rating (in progress)
- runbook-bot: execute key rotation script once approved
- sophie_legal: evidence preservation & comms draft

lina_security: initial risk: MED-HIGH. Roughly 12 customer orgs have token-ish fragments in sampled logs. Need full scan to confirm scope.

emily_sre: found deploy audit: config change came from infra user `deploy-ci` via PR #4820 at 04:08UTC. Rolling back that specific config now to prevent re-ingest.

miguel_ops: prepping key rotation. preliminary command: ```sh
./tools/rotate-keys --service logshipper --rotate-svc-account --notify-systems=false
``` Pause: we should coordinate with runbook before pushing.

runbook-bot: rotation pre-checks: all ingesters paused, snapshots created, legal hold flagged. Ready to run on approval.

raj_oncall: approved to rotate now. miguel, runbook-bot coordinate and post confirmation. lina, once rotation done start full scan for token exposures and ID list for comms.

miguel_ops: running rotation now. will post status updates every 2 min.

miguel_ops: rotation step 1/3 complete: old keys disabled. 2/3 creating new keys. 3/3 deploying new keys to logshipper vault.

miguel_ops: rotation complete. new keys live. logshipper role revoked from external principals.

emily_sre: verified no new ingestion after rotation+rollback. WAF rule blocking continues. snapshot artifact uploaded: s3://incident-artifacts/2833337777/snapshots.tar.gz (access: security+oncall)

lina_security: full scan started against s3 buckets and logs. ETA 40m. current high-confidence exposures: 9 tokens that match customer token regex; flagging 12 orgs for followup (some overlap).

sophie_legal: drafting comms template. recommend initial notification: "investigating potential exposure of short-lived tokens; tokens rotated; no evidence of misuse so far; we will update within 24 hours." Holding for security confirmation.

raj_oncall: good. no external customer comms until lina confirms scope. internal stakeholders: support/growth/eng-plat on watch. I'll create a bridge for customer-facing teams.

lina_security: scanning result update: 12 orgs inside sample window; 4 show token usage after potential exposure window — those require priority review for suspicious API activity.

emily_sre: started lightweight anomaly checks on API gateway for those 4 orgs. Nothing conclusive yet. Will escalate if anything odd.

miguel_ops: added short TTL to new keys and scheduled automated rotation for next 1h as defense-in-depth.

sophie_legal: approved comms template w/ one small wording tweak. ready when security thumbs up.

raj_oncall: summary to post in incident channel and CIRT: isolation done, rotation complete, initial exposure list generated (12 orgs), deeper scan ongoing, legal drafting comms, no confirmed customer impact yet. Next update in 30m or on significant findings.

lina_security: noted. assigning triage owners for the 4 priority orgs: @emily_sre (org-1234), @miguel_ops (org-5678), @raj_oncall (org-9012), @lina_security (org-4321).

raj_oncall: handing off active monitoring to night oncall @sabin_night at 03:00 UTC. I will leave a running notes doc and escalate if anything changes. Good work team. :thumbsup:
